steps.name: NEAR withdrawn from Intents into buybacks.multisignature.near
steps.status: observed (receipts, valued at the daily NEAR price); attribution to executed purchases inferred
steps.note: 3081 inbound transfers from intents.near from 2026-03-18 to 2026-11-01; a further 510,068 NEAR arrived from the other revenue wallets (treasury moves, excluded here as the adapter excludes them) and 8,293 NEAR from other accounts. Trace of a pre-declared sample (45 of 3197 receipts, every 80th plus the five largest): 45 match a dip4 native_withdraw of wrapped NEAR from 16 distinct Intents-side accounts; for 16 the funding swap (token_diff of the same account, 16 buying wrap.near) is in the same blocks, for the other 29 it is outside the blocks read and the purchase is not observed. A second pre-declared pass over those found the funding swap within 200 blocks before the withdrawal for 12 more (28 of 45 in total). Population from BigQuery: of 3,197 withdrawals (1,695,932 NEAR) the funding exchange is observed for 1,926 (60% of receipts, 69% of the NEAR); the sold asset reached the account by a bridge deposit in 0 cases and by an internal transfer in 1,925. Exchange and origin are observed where they appear; the remaining receipts have no wrap.near purchase by the same account in the day before the withdrawal, so for them the economic operation stays unobserved. Receipts excluded: 0 failed, 0 without an explicit status. The wallet was created 2026-03-18, after the adapter's buyback start 2026-02-23, so labelled revenue before that date cannot be matched to this wallet

steps.name: Destination at the analysis cutoff (ledger reconstructed from receipts)
steps.status: inferred: balance at the cutoff reconstructed from receipts; the snapshot balance is shown separately at its own date
steps.note: inbound before the cutoff minus outbound (12,025 NEAR) minus gas, divided by all inbound NEAR before the cutoff. Snapshot balance at fetch 2,202,268 NEAR versus 2,202,268 NEAR reconstructed to the same date (residual -0.3 NEAR); inflows after the cutoff 52,070 NEAR. No burn observed; holding is not supply destruction

dilution.measure: total supply change: protocol issuance net of gas burn; unlocks of already-issued tokens are not dilution of supply

circulating_supply_field.note: constant in the NearBlocks snapshot over the window, so it is not used

dilution.buyback_measure: NEAR withdrawn from Intents into the buyback wallet (observed); purchase attribution inferred
dilution.note: buybacks are held, not burned, so they do not reduce supply and are not netted twice: issuance is counted once here and buybacks once above

ledger.method: sum of successful inbound TRANSFER receipts minus outbound TRANSFER receipts minus gas of wallet-signed transactions; no storage or staking terms

rule.declared: 2026-11-07, before reading any of these blocks
rule.sample: inbound TRANSFER receipts from intents.near sorted by block timestamp: every 80th receipt starting at the first, plus the five largest by amount
rule.what_is_read: the blocks from the originating transaction's block to the block in which the receipt executed (at most 8): dip4 native_withdraw / intents_executed and nep245 mt_burn events whose receiver and amount match the receipt, plus any dip4 token_diff event of the same Intents account in those blocks
rule.what_it_establishes: the NEAR arrived as a withdrawal from an Intents-side account balance (observed for every sampled receipt); the purchase itself is the earlier token_diff of the same account, observed only when it falls inside the blocks read, so purchase attribution for the whole inflow remains inferred

rule.population: every native_withdraw log of intents.near whose receiver is the buyback wallet on the days with inbound receipts (2026-04-23 to 2026-11-06), from the NEAR public BigQuery dataset
rule.exchange: the latest token_diff of the same Intents-side account that bought wrap.near, at or before the withdrawal block, searching back one day of blocks
rule.origin: a bridge deposit (mt_mint) or an internal transfer (mt_transfer) of an asset sold in that exchange to the same account, within one day before the exchange
rule.what_it_establishes: the withdrawal and the exchange are observed on-chain for every receipt they cover; the origin shows how the sold asset reached the account; whether the operator intended the withdrawal as a buyback remains an interpretation of the flows

reconciliation_with_nearblocks_snapshot.note: ids differ by construction (log-emitting receipt versus the child transfer receipt); matching is on UTC day and exact amount

full_attribution.reading: of 3,197 withdrawals (1,695,932 NEAR) the funding exchange is observed for 1,926 (60% of receipts, 69% of the NEAR); the sold asset reached the account by a bridge deposit in 0 cases and by an internal transfer in 1,925. Exchange and origin are observed where they appear; the remaining receipts have no wrap.near purchase by the same account in the day before the withdrawal, so for them the economic operation stays unobserved

rule.declared: 2026-11-07, after the first trace was published and before any additional block was read: up to 40 blocks; extended the same day to 200 blocks after 6 of 29 were found within 40, before reading any block beyond the 40th
rule.population: the sampled receipts whose Intents account had no token_diff in the blocks between the originating transaction and the receipt
rule.search: read the blocks immediately before the originating transaction block, newest first, up to the declared depth (40 blocks is about 45 seconds, 200 about four minutes), and stop at the first block that carries a token_diff event of that Intents account
rule.what_it_establishes: whether the funding swap of the withdrawal is visible shortly before it; a swap found this way is an observed exchange of the same Intents-side account, not proof that the withdrawn NEAR was bought with those exact proceeds; the origin of the sold asset (bridge deposit, earlier swap) is not traced

dominant_assumption.method: one at a time: each input moved from its base to its adverse value, others held at base; ranked by the absolute change in net yield

what_weakens_the_thesis: issuance above buyback accrual in every scenario means settlement growth does not translate into net token accrual; a fall in volume or capture, or an allocation decision away from buybacks, removes the accrual entirely
